results.question: How do I install Claude Code on Windows?
results.answer:
Here's a complete guide to installing Claude Code on Windows, based on Syracuse University's official setup documentation [[986841103]]:

---

## 🖥️ Installing Claude Code on Windows

### Step 1: Get Access to Claude Code
Before installing, you'll need to purchase or obtain access to Claude Code. See the [Purchase Claude Code and Claude API Access](https://answers.atlassian.syr.edu/wiki/spaces/ITSAI/pages/540934169/Purchase+Claude+Code+and+Claude+API+Access) page for details [[986841103]].

---

### Step 2: Install Claude Code & Development Tools

SU provides an **automated PowerShell script** (`Install-DevTools.ps1`) that handles everything. It auto-detects your system architecture (AMD64 or ARM64) and installs all required tools [[986841103]]:

| Tool | Version | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Node.js | 24.12.0 | Portable/embedded |
| Git Portable | 2.52.0 | Includes Git Bash |
| Python Embeddable | 3.14.3 | Skipped if system Python detected |
| VS Code Portable | Latest | Skipped if already installed |
| GitHub Desktop | Latest | Visual Git interface |
| PowerShell 7 | Latest | Via winget |
| **Claude Code** | Latest | Always installs locally |

**A) Set the Execution Policy**

Open PowerShell and run:
```powershell
Set-ExecutionPolicy -ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned -Scope CurrentUser
```

**B) Download the Script**

Download [`Install-DevTools.ps1`](https://answers.atlassian.syr.edu/wiki/spaces/ITSAI/pages/986841103/Claude+Code+Setup) from the setup page and save it (e.g., to your Downloads folder).

**C) Remove the "Mark of the Web" (Windows Block)**

Windows blocks scripts downloaded from the internet. Unblock the file first using **one** of these methods:

- **PowerShell (recommended):**
  ```powershell
  Unblock-File -Path "$HOME\Downloads\Install-DevTools.ps1"
  ```
- **File Properties:** Right-click the file → Properties → check **Unblock** at the bottom → click OK.

**D) Run the Script**

```powershell
# Installs all tools to OneDrive by default (syncs across devices)
.\Install-DevTools.ps1
```

> 📁 By default, tools install to `%OneDrive%\Apps-SU\[arch]\<ToolName>`. Claude Code itself always installs locally to `%USERPROFILE%\.local\bin` [[986841103]].

---

### Step 3: Configure Claude Code

Once installed, connect Claude Code to your SU account [[986841103]]:

1. Open a terminal and type: `claude`
2. Choose your preferred text display style.
3. Select **"Anthropic Console account"** (option 2) for your login method.
4. A browser window will open — sign in with your **`netid@syr.edu`** credentials. If prompted, select the **Syracuse University** organization.
5. **Authorize Claude Code** in the browser.
6. Return to the terminal and **press Enter twice** to accept and trust the folder.

✅ **You're all set!**

---

### Troubleshooting Tips

- **Script won't run?** Try bypassing the execution policy for a single session:
  ```powershell
  Set-ExecutionPolicy -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Scope Process
  ```
  Or from Command Prompt: `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\Install-DevTools.ps1`
- **No OneDrive?** Use the `-Location Local` flag when running the script.
- **32-bit systems** are not supported — only AMD64 and ARM64.
- After installation, **restart your terminal** if tools aren't recognized [[986841103]].

---

### Optional Add-ons
- **GitHub Integration:** Use Git to track every change Claude Code makes, create branches to experiment safely, and roll back if needed [[986841103]].
- **VS Code Integration:** Follow the [Claude Code VS Code Integration Guide](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/vs-code) for an enhanced coding experience [[986841103]].

---

**Sources:**
- [Claude Code Setup](https://answers.atlassian.syr.edu/wiki/spaces/ITSAI/pages/986841103/Claude+Code+Setup) [[986841103]]

results.question: How do I create a new mentor on the Clementine platform?
results.answer:
Here's a step-by-step guide to creating a new mentor on the Clementine (mentorAI) platform [[535068673]]:

---

## Creating a New Mentor on mentorAI

### Step 1: Start a New Mentor
Click the **"New Mentor"** button on your dashboard.

---

### Step 2: Input Mentor Information
Fill in the following details:

- **Name** – Enter the mentor's name. This is the primary identifier mentees will see when looking to connect.
- **Description** – Write a brief bio covering the mentor's background, skills, and the type of mentorship offered (e.g., career advice, skill development).
- **Category** – Select the appropriate category based on the mentor's expertise (e.g., Astronomy, Art, Anthropology). This helps mentees find relevant mentors.
- **Mentor Visibility** – Choose whether the mentor is visible to all students, select groups, or kept private.
- **Image** – Optionally upload a profile picture to make the profile more engaging and relatable.

---

### Step 3: Configure Prompts
Set up the interaction prompts to shape how the mentor engages with mentees:

- **System Prompts** – These are pre-populated with suggested interaction styles. Review and edit them to match the mentor's focus and tone.
- **Proactive Prompts** – Add prompts that initiate discussions with mentees. Tailor these to encourage specific types of interactions.
- **Guided Prompts** – Set structured guidance for conversations, relevant to the mentor's expertise and the mentee's needs.

> 💡 **Tip:** Add your configured prompts at the bottom of the default prompts for more effective mentoring.

---

### Step 4: Save
Click the **"Save"** button to submit the new mentor profile.

---

For additional configuration options (such as LLM selection, datasets, and safety settings), you can refer to the **mentorAI Settings & Options** page.

---

**Sources:**
- [mentorAI Creating A Mentor](https://answers.atlassian.syr.edu/wiki/spaces/ITSAI/pages/535068673/mentorAI+Creating+A+Mentor) [[535068673]]

results.question: Where can I find example uses of Claude for academic work?
results.answer:
Great news — Syracuse University has a dedicated set of example use pages for Claude, including two that are especially relevant for academic work. Here's a summary:

---

## 📚 Example Uses of Claude for Academic Work

### 1. AI Research Assistant with Claude [[572194844]]
This is the most comprehensive academic example. It covers:

- **Uploading documents** (PDFs, Word docs, research articles) — up to 5 files per conversation — and asking Claude to summarize, extract quotes, or explain theories
- **Using Projects** to organize readings by course or topic, so you don't have to re-upload materials each time
- **Multi-Document Analysis** — upload multiple sources and ask Claude to synthesize them into a comparison table or literature review
- **Creating Artifacts** — editable outlines, summaries, and literature reviews in a side panel
- **Web Search Integration** — Claude can search for current research and provide citations
- **Extended Thinking** — for deeper analysis of complex research questions

**Example prompts provided include:**
- *"Summarize this research article in 3–4 bullet points…"*
- *"Compare these two articles on [topic]… create a comparison table"*
- *"Create an outline for a short literature review on [topic] using the uploaded sources"*
- *"Extract 5–7 key quotes from this article that support the main argument"*

> ⚠️ **Important reminder:** Always verify sources through SU Libraries for peer-reviewed material, and always cite original sources — Claude is a research aid, not a replacement for critical thinking.

---

### 2. Claude Study Project [[511279124]]
This example shows how to use Claude's **Study Project** feature for mastering course content:

- Create a Study Project from Claude's home screen
- Upload lecture slides, PDFs, or notes
- Ask Claude to **generate flashcards**, **quiz you**, or **summarize chapters**

---

There are also three other example use pages (meeting summaries, career/resume help, and drafting emails) if those are relevant to you.

---

## Sources
- [AI Research Assistant with Claude](https://answers.atlassian.syr.edu/wiki/spaces/ITSAI/pages/572194844/AI+Research+Assistant+with+Claude) [[572194844]]
- [Claude Study Project](https://answers.atlassian.syr.edu/wiki/spaces/ITSAI/pages/511279124/Claude+Study+Project) [[511279124]]
